title: Line sketch: Mysterious Mushroom Portrait
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A stylized mushroom with large white eyes stares directly at the viewer, creating an eerie yet whimsical character against a simple gradient background. The detailed gills and textured stem add depth to this surreal composition from a daily art challenge (derived from painting #413).
